propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate processed business subscription renewals in the billing system, checking seat counts against the admin console export before each invoice run.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the renewal processing and the seat check directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate maintained the billing-correction checklist and the correction-cause list and added a pre-invoice seat check.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the checklist work sample document the maintenance and the added step.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate's pre-invoice seat check reduced manual corrections from one in five renewals to almost none.
propositions.rationale: The figure appears only in the candidate's own cover email without a report, baseline or period.

expectedGap: No report, baseline or period in the materials measures the share of renewals needing manual correction before and after the seat check.
expectedBoundaryNote: Treat the cover-email figure as the candidate's own claim; the materials document the checklist change, not the change in correction rate.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the quarterly correction-rate report or the billing-system extract that shows corrections before and after the seat check was introduced.
